regime_context: The detector shows a narrow leadership rotation concentrated in Semiconductors (rank 1, eligible, trending) with AI Compute & Optics as a close challenger. Pharma is durable but crowded. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown in this market’s history (gate_helps=false), so all leans are experimental and must be held at low conviction. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics, with a high share of unscheduled surprises — no reliable thematic trigger.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics: watch for a confirmed handoff if rank overtakes Semiconductors over the next 20 days while durability >0.5 holds; kill if Semiconductors re-extends margin above 0.3 or AI Compute durability falls below 0.3.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the eligible, trend-state leader (hurst=trend) with durability above 0.5, positive momentum score and no crowding; while rank does not predict returns, the lack of fragility flags and the absence of a one-narrative extreme suggest the flow concentration could persist. Overweight, conditional on trend health.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate’s historical failure in China A-shares (mean-reversion whipsaws) means trending themes are vulnerable to sharp reversals; the narrow rotation (only 23% of themes eligible) signals fragile leadership, and the desk’s own track record on this market is below 50% hit rate.

falsifier.text: If Semiconductors’ durability drops below 0.4 or its hurst tag shifts from ‘trend’ to ‘mixed’ or ‘mean-revert’, the overweight lean is invalidated.
